label: HireWorkspace
prompt: Make vacancies readable and welcoming, prioritizing role, location, and application requirements. Keep own application status clear and private; use restrained forms and orderly hiring information without revealing interview feedback or reviewed handoff details across roles. Keep daisyUI theme and shared shell defaults, canonical permissions/actions, localized labels, complete forms/errors, visible keyboard focus, and responsive stacking. Apply consistently to each styled page content scope; keep page admission and the shared shell unchanged.
